title: White Kitchen — Yasnaya Polyana
source: Ordinary museum ground photograph and viewed aerial image; no mapped building ownership.
axis: Native east/up/south axes baked; X southeast along estimated roof, front+Z southwest toward flower bed.
identityStatus: The museum group photograph identifies the central low log White Kitchen, green hip, pale chimney, left wooden door and two divided white windows. Ordinary aerial imagery shows the matching separate green roof in the service courtyard behind Tolstoy House, with the southwest flower bed matching the ground photo. The retained PMTiles and current OSM neighborhood map omit this footprint; reject toilet way167382259 as unrelated. Photo-derived roof center[37.526028,54.076367] and9.6x7m plan are author estimates, about5m positional/15degree facing uncertainty, not an OSM or surveyed footprint. X southeast follows the visible roof; front+Z southwest faces the flower bed. Existing mapped buildings stay independent.

Photo/aerial interpretation, with explicit positional and hidden-detail uncertainty. No adjacent icehouse/woodshed, planting, sign lettering, people or copied photo pixels are baked in.
